## Install

1. Download **`FormRelay-<version>-win-x64.zip`** below (and check it against the `.sha256` file if you like).
2. Right-click the zip → **Extract All**.
3. Double-click **`FormRelay-Setup.cmd`** → **1. Install**.

You need Windows 10/11 or Server 2019+ and SQL Server. The free [SQL Server Express](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/sql-server/sql-server-downloads) is fine (choose *Express*, then *Basic*).

**Already installed?** Run `"C:\Program Files\FormRelay\FormRelay-Setup.cmd"` and choose **2. Update**, or `FormRelay-Setup.ps1 update -Latest`.

Full guide: [docs/install.md](https://github.com/cmcclea117-gif/FormRelay/blob/main/docs/install.md) | Problems: [docs/troubleshooting.md](https://github.com/cmcclea117-gif/FormRelay/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)
